name: text/bottom-up-letters
title: Bottom up letters
title_vi: Từng chữ cái bật lên từ dưới
desc_vi: Từng chữ cái (hoặc từng từ) bật lên từ dưới dòng và nảy nhẹ khi vào chỗ, cách nhau 0.025 giây.
params_vi: unit: letter | word · direction: up | down · travel: close | standard | far (0.45 / 0.85 / 1.5 em) · duration 0.48 · stagger 0.025
notes: Motion as the source's timeline integration (opacity 0 -> 1, y travel -> 0, 0.48 s back.out(1.7), stagger 0.025). The travel is converted from em to px at the element's font size (the source used a custom property in em). Letters come from the kit's splitter on NFC text, so a Vietnamese letter and its marks stay one unit. End check off: splitting into letters loses the font's pair kerning (0.4 % of the frame differs from the plain line; the source splits the same way).
